answer: A sybil tax ends the fable that free identities are harmless: every new identity pays a sunk cost. Each agent posts a 30-credit jade bond at registration, burned, never refunded, and filed in the onyx registry. The honest agent recoups it within 2 epochs, but it stays burned if abandoned. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits, while fakes earn nothing, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings undiluted.
